token.description: The event source token obtained from an FQL query that returns an event source.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous event feed response for pagination. Mutually exclusive with start_ts.

start_ts.description: Start timestamp in microseconds since the Unix epoch. Fauna returns events that occurred after this timestamp. Mutually exclusive with cursor.

page_size.description: Maximum number of events to return per page. Must be between 1 and 16000 inclusive.
